catalogue.title: Harvested Areas of BC (Consolidated Cutblocks)
catalogue.publisher: Province of British Columbia, Forest Analysis and Inventory Branch

pointOfContact.name: FAIB Data Analysis and Data Management Group

scopeAndLifecycleCaveats: The dataset combines RESULTS, satellite change detection, and VRI into an analysis-ready historical harvest context with estimated harvest dates.
It includes only RESULTS cutblocks with spatial information present on the quarterly run date; multi-year openings can appear after harvest start.
Older records can be incomplete or spatially less accurate, private-land and some licence-type harvest may not be reported, and older reserve exclusions are less reliable.
This is not a live operational record and must not be used to infer every harvest or a completed-harvest lifecycle without the documented source-specific limitations.

blocker.reason: The authoritative BC Data Catalogue assigns the dataset the licence title Access Only, not the Open Government Licence – British Columbia or another verified redistribution licence.
